recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit or resurrect the retired STU3 EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse spreadsheet sources; the active R6 resource definitions and later applied Jira decisions already preserve the required patient context.
issue_request: FHIR-17260 is a Published/Persuasive FM change request from STU3 asking for a Patient element because there is no context conduction; its resolution says to add Patient to EligibilityRequest and EligibilityResponse, while the summary also mentioned EnrollmentResponse.
initial_application: Historical commit 10ac2496c7fa29fe458c13a1ef3f7edb89485acc, whose tracker list includes 17260, added EligibilityRequest.patient and EligibilityResponse.patient rows and patient search metadata to the STU3 spreadsheet sources. Those old EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse files are no longer active current-build resources.
additional_context: FHIR-16936 renamed EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse and left Enrollment as separate resources. source/fhir.ini now actively lists CoverageEligibilityRequest, CoverageEligibilityResponse, EnrollmentRequest, and EnrollmentResponse, while old EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse abbreviations are commented and the deleted-resource note records the rename. FHIR-19493 later made CoverageEligibilityResponse.patient mandatory. FHIR-43122 later added EnrollmentResponse.candidate with Patient and Group targets and a patient search parameter. FHIR-43123 is a broader Triaged group-coverage issue and was not treated as a final source-edit decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already contains CoverageEligibilityRequest.patient 1..1 Reference(Patient), CoverageEligibilityResponse.patient 1..1 Reference(Patient), EnrollmentRequest.candidate Reference(Patient|Group), EnrollmentResponse.candidate Reference(Patient|Group), and patient search parameters for the relevant active resources.

related_jiras.note: Renamed EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse, explaining the active source names. Already represented on the combined branch.
Made CoverageEligibilityResponse.patient and other response fields mandatory after the original patient element was added. Already represented on the combined branch.
Added EnrollmentResponse.candidate and a patient search parameter, resolving the no-context-conduction concern for EnrollmentResponse in current source.
Broader group-level coverage discussion remains Triaged and does not change this seed decision.
